_source: CPR core p.412-416 (Mooks and Grunts, Lieutenants, Mini Bosses, a Boss), read off the page images. Hardened series (R. Talsorian free DLCs: Hardened Mooks, Hardened Lieutenants, Hardened Mini Bosses), read off the page images; cited 'RTG Hardened Mooks/LTs/Mini Bosses p.N'. Night City 2045 district STAT blocks (112), cited by PDF page 'NC2045 p.N', converted from the book's compact format. Numbers as printed; skill values are SKILL BASES (STAT + skill). Encounter budget p.399-400.
_doc: tiers: the encounter-budget tiers (weight = Edgerunners' worth, p.399) with the default pool of blocks a faction without its own falls back to (core blocks only); hardened_blocks lists the tier's Hardened-series blocks, kept out of the default pool (they are balanced against combat-optimised crews). blocks: one entry per printed stat block. stats/hp/seriously_wounded/death_save/skills as printed (hp is used when it differs from the formula); armor head/body are armor.json ids, or a cyberware id (Subdermal Armor, Skinweave; armor_is_cyberware) or "" for none (sp is the printed SP, for checking); weapons are weapons.json ids, primary first (may be empty for an unarmed block: Brawling and Martial Arts attacks are unarmed and live in skills), with weapon_quality where printed and weapon_sources naming the cyberware a built-in weapon comes from; cyberware are cyberware.json ids (repeated for pairs); kit lists gear.json keys (the kit items among them are carried into the fight; the rest is flavour until modelled), kit_qty the printed counts above 1, kit_detail what a key stands for. role_ability {role, name, rank, detail} is the printed role ability (not yet modelled). unmapped/unverified: what isn't modelled or couldn't be checked. Skills written skill:specialisation (language:streetslang) are kept for reference and skipped by the game until specialisations exist; Martial Arts (form) is stored as martial_arts. hardened: true for Hardened-series blocks and NC2045 blocks labelled 'Hardened' (absent = false). NC2045 blocks add district (city.districts id), faction (tools/nc_faction_ids.txt id, "" when none), com (the printed COM #), init (printed INIT), reputation, cash (eb), civilian: true for service/civilian blocks (doctors, vendors, drivers, performers, staff), which take tier mook whatever the print says (printed_tier keeps the label), and gm_choice (which parts the book leaves to the GM: weapons, armor). The compact format prints only COM #/INIT/COOL/MOVE/HP(DS), so by the owner-approved rule: BODY = Death Save (minus 2 when Grafted Muscle & Bone Lace is fitted, since the cyberware adds it back); REF = INIT (minus Kerenzikov's +2); COOL and MOVE as printed; WILL chosen so 10+5*ceil((BODY+WILL)/2) = printed HP; every weapon skill used by its attacks (incl. autofire for autofire-capable guns, brawling, martial_arts) = COM #; INT/DEX/TECH/EMP/LUCK from the same-tier template (Hardened Mook: hardened_security_operative, Mook: security_operative, Lieutenant: security_officer, Hardened Lieutenant: hardened_security_officer_raid, Hardened Mini Boss: hardened_militech_veteran); each block's first unverified line records its derived values. complications: the Hardened DLCs' d10 tables (mook: Mook Encounter Complication, lieutenant: Hardened Lieutenant Tactics, mini_boss: Mini Boss Mini Promotion; _cite) as {roll, text (paraphrase), fx}. fx keys (all optional; {} = not machine-expressible): affects (how many of the fielded units it applies to; absent = the tier's unit), add_units (extra units), round / rounds (when they arrive; absent = at the start), unit ('different_type' = another block of the tier, 'team_member' = a follower), crit_injury (location of a Critical Injury each added unit starts with), kit (gear.json key given), qty (its count), drug (gear.json drugs id in effect; a list = pick one), when ('pre_combat'), skill_base ({skill: base} set), skill_base_raise ({above, to, count}: raise that many bases above `above` to `to`), stat_set ({STAT: value}), stat_bonus ({STAT: +n}, before the armour penalty), armor ({head/body: armor id, "" = none}), no_armor_penalty, weapon (weapons.json id given), ai ('reckless'), tactic (ambush, human_shield, focus_fire, charge, hold_cover, command), trap ({kit, spot_dv, spot_skill, disarm_dv, disarm_skill}: goes off when a character enters its square), reputation, facedown (opens with a Facedown), hp_bonus, role_ability ({role, name, rank}), cyberware_eb (eb of extra cyberware), cyberware (ids added), choose (a list of fx, pick one).

tier_guidance.mook: About one Mook per Edgerunner; up to 2 per Edgerunner against a combat-heavy crew (p.399, p.413).
tier_guidance.lieutenant: 1 Lieutenant per 2 Edgerunners; top up with Mooks so total weight equals crew size (p.399, p.414).
tier_guidance.mini_boss: 1 Mini Boss per 3 Edgerunners, with Lieutenants/Mooks added until weight equals the crew (p.400, p.415).
tier_guidance.boss: Cyberpsycho is a full boss battle; only for a crew that can handle it. No count given (p.416).
tier_guidance.gear_note: Upgrading an enemy's gear (e.g. a Mook with a top-tier pistol) or counting a heavily geared PC as 2-3 Edgerunners also scales difficulty (p.400).
